name: Magibar Window Management
description: Lets Magibar snap, move, and resize windows on a GNOME Wayland session. Wayland has no cross-application window-control protocol, so an external app cannot move another app's window on its own; this extension runs inside GNOME Shell and exposes a small private D-Bus API that only Magibar calls. Does nothing on its own — with Magibar uninstalled it just sits idle.
